mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to earnings headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized), robust GDP growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized.
